gen-dafont-arkhip-gf-stint-ultra-expande: Stint Ultra Expanded spreads its serif letters wide apart, each character floating alone, with a pipe-cleaner feel running through every shape. Arkhip, the heading, carries that looseness on with no thick-and-thin shading.
gen-dafont-azonix-gf-fauna-one: Fauna One reads dignified, its tall middle band keeping ascenders and descenders shallow. Azonix does best with wide-mouthed letters that stay crisp when shrunk, while Fauna One does best at letting literary text settle in.
gen-dafont-azonix-gf-glegoo: Glegoo gives its tall lowercase big counters. Curved letters keep wide, unclosed mouths, so long reading moves along with an editorial ease, well away from Azonix and its commanding heft.
gen-dafont-azonix-gf-noticia-text: Strokes drawn as if with a fixed pen give Azonix its commanding look. Noticia Text then reads at a literary, dignified pace, its curved letters showing a big visible entrance.
gen-dafont-azonix-gf-piazzolla: Piazzolla keeps its lowercase nearly as tall as its capitals, with an e pried wide open. But Azonix is at its best bent like a single length of wire, and Piazzolla at carrying refined text.
gen-dafont-azonix-gf-slabo-13px: Slabo 13px gives its tall a, e and s large open counters. Slabo 13px stays readable beneath Azonix, whose stout, pipe-cleaner strokes do all the shouting, so the two split the work.
gen-dafont-azonix-gf-suwannaphum: Suwannaphum is a dignified serif whose c opens like a bent paperclip and whose x-height reaches high, squared off like woodblock type. Azonix cuts like laser sheet; Suwannaphum does the editorial talking.
gen-dafont-azonix-instrument-sans: Crisp and commanding, Azonix leads while Instrument Sans follows with open-pincer c shapes and a minimal cap-to-lowercase step. Paragraphs of it keep one unvarying stroke weight from first line to last.
gen-dafont-blockletter-bitter: Dependable describes Bitter, a slab-serif with very large lowercase eyes and a see-through gap in each s. Bitter handles the grounded body text, leaving Blockletter to do the precise, modern shouting.
gen-dafont-blockletter-gf-epunda-slab: Epunda Slab shows off a visibly gaping c at any size. What stands out is the meeting of Blockletter, drawn in one unbroken line weight, with that classic, dignified serif's tall rounded lowercase.
